services.name: Yard drainage
services.blurb: Standing water on red clay given a route out of the yard and away from the house.

services.name: French drains
services.blurb: Pipe in washed stone and fabric, run downhill to a daylight outlet or the ditch.

services.name: Swales and regrading
services.blurb: A shallow grassed dip shaped across the lot so storm water walks instead of pooling.

services.name: Driveway culverts and ditches
services.blurb: Clogged or crushed pipes dug out and reset so the road ditch flows again.

services.name: Storm washout repair
services.blurb: Gullies and washed-out drives filled, packed and rocked after a summer storm.

services.name: Foundation digs
services.blurb: Footings and crawlspace digs in clay, with the spoil kept off your lawn.

services.name: Utility trenching
services.blurb: Trenches for water, power and sewer lines, dug after the locate marks.

services.name: Gravel driveways
services.blurb: Crusher run base and top rock spread on red clay so the drive stops rutting.

services.name: Pond digging and cleanout
services.blurb: New ponds dug and old silted ponds cleaned out, with the dam edges shaped.

services.name: Debris haul-off
services.blurb: Storm limbs, old slabs and dirt piles loaded up and hauled off the lot.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.name: Loretta H.
reviews.text: Our brick ranch on the north side had red mud coming under the back door every July. Otis walked the yard with me in the rain, pointed at where the water wanted to go, and gave it a path. First dry summer in years.

reviews.name: Terrence B.
reviews.text: Good people. They ran the drain out past the pines to the ditch and raked the clay back so smooth my wife asked if they'd even dug.

reviews.name: Faye C.
reviews.text: The pipe under our drive was crushed flat and the ditch backed into the yard. They dug it up, set a bigger pipe and rocked both ends. Rained hard two days later, water went right through.

reviews.name: Ezra J.
reviews.text: A thunderstorm cut a gully clean through our gravel drive. Called that evening, they were out the next morning, filled it, packed it, and put in a little turnout so it won't happen again.

reviews.name: Nell R.
reviews.text: Our old farm pond had silted up to a mud flat. Otis's son ran the machine for three days, cleaned it down to the old bottom and shaped the bank. Fish are back, so are the herons.

reviews.name: Quincy A.
reviews.text: The neighbour's new house sent all his runoff into our garden. They shaped a swale along the line and seeded it. Nobody had to argue, the water just goes around now.

proof.guarantee: If the water still pools where we fixed it after the next real rain, we come back and rework it.
